# WebTea HQ — AI-readable company brief

## Identity
WebTea HQ is an AI-powered digital agency and startup headquartered in Bettiah, Bihar, India. It was founded on 7 July 2026 by Aryan Singh and Ayush Singh.

## Meaning
Web represents internet-related work. Tea represents the beverage. WebTea describes online-related work made as simple as sipping tea. HQ means Headquarters.

## Positioning
WebTea HQ helps businesses establish, build, automate and grow their digital presence.

## Services
Websites, web apps, digital products, AI systems, automation, SEO, digital marketing, social media, content creation, editing, shoots, motion graphics, advertising, branding and digital presence work.

## Founders
- Aryan Singh, also known as Young Aaru — Co-Founder & Chief Technology Officer.
- Ayush Singh, also known as The OG Ayush — Co-Founder & Chief Marketing & Creative Officer.

## Team
- Raunak Sharma, also known as Raunak Jr. — WebTea HQ team member.

## AI team
- Hinata — AI Executive Assistant.
- Satoshi — AI Strategy & Operations.

## Market
WebTea HQ primarily serves Indian clients and can serve international clients.

## Headquarters
Bettiah, Bihar, India.
